svg.title: The matrix names which real component owns each primitive in every deployment shape; shape 2 owns all listed primitives, but its container and mount are not a hostile-code sandbox.
svg.desc: For eleven deployment shapes, the table names the component that provides the harness, sandbox, session plus checkpoint, and trace. The queue-plus-worker default owns its worker, container and mount, an explicit Postgres session-event schema plus PostgresSaver checkpoint state, and an OpenTelemetry stack. The local Compose row has PostgresSaver only and still needs that event schema in production. That container and mount provide an execution boundary but are insufficient for hostile code, which needs a hardened sandbox or VM. Anthropic Managed Agents is the only shape where a single vendor owns all four.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
